<!-- pr-reviewer: 791dede4ba2a3c214b0bfeba5e2a5562d13d4c82 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The tests cover both shipped lathe posts. They check the cycle mapping, feed-out motion, dwell, off-axis refusal, and exact output. The decision file explains the scope. No production code, dependency, importer, or UI changed.

Results merged with main, locally:

- Base: upstream/main at c4ac3ce6da5d79e572b82ec94bc965427cd63eeb. The trial merge was clean.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 100 steps passed. The post suites ran 839 tests; none failed or were ignored.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: no heavy lane applies.
- Both new G-code goldens were checked line by line. The checks include units, plane, tool, spindle, feed per revolution, approach, retract, cycle cancellation, and program end.

Extra suites run:

A source search found two readers of `tests/golden/ream/`. Both ran again after the mutations were removed:

- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-post --test ream_cycle --test ream_lathe`: 5 mill tests and 7 lathe tests passed.
- No test data or importer change requires the kernel or app import suites.

Mutations run locally:

- Removed the Fanuc REAM-to-G85 mapping. The Fanuc cycle test, dwell test, and golden test failed. Result: 4 passed, 3 failed.
- Made the Tormach post refuse REAM with TAP. The Tormach feed-out test, dwell test, and golden test failed. Result: 4 passed, 3 failed.
- Restored both scripts. All 7 lathe tests passed. The review worktree had no file changes after restoration.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes: These are synthetic regression programs. No control or machine validation was done. The PR states this limit.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merge note: this PR merges now at head `791dede4ba2a3c214b0bfeba5e2a5562d13d4c82`.

- Class: no refresh. The head is the reviewed head.
- Review: the `pr-reviewer` marker of mkinney's review agent on this head. A collaborator set `merge-ready`.
- The PR adds tests and goldens only. It does not touch a `P1`, so no second review is necessary.
